moduleName: Classic Cricket Auction (tournament uploads, franchise + player auctions, scoring)

requirements.businessContext: Cricket leagues play on a tournament (e.g. IPL 2026) whose teams, players, fixtures and per-match fantasy points the superadmin uploads as spreadsheets — there is no cricket API. Managers build squads in a live franchise auction (one franchise each, IPL leagues only) and a live player auction; every squad player scores their points, own-franchise players get a % boost, and the highest total wins. Design: docs/11-cricket.md.

userStories.iWant: to upload a tournament's teams, players, fixtures and points as spreadsheets, with a preview before anything is saved
userStories.soThat: cricket leagues have data without a paid API, and a bad sheet never lands

userStories.iWant: to create a Classic Cricket Auction league on a tournament with its own purse, squad rules and franchise boost
userStories.soThat: each league can tune its auction

userStories.iWant: to run the franchise and player auction sessions (start, pause, resume, complete) and correct mistakes
userStories.soThat: the auction runs live with the league

userStories.iWant: to nominate and bid in a live auction room
a wishlist that nominates for me if I miss my turn
userStories.soThat: a missed turn doesn't cost me a squad slot

userStories.iWant: standings computed from every squad player's points with my franchise boost
userStories.soThat: the table reflects the matches as soon as points are uploaded

userStories.iWant: cricket league pages (standings, fixtures, pool, squads, rules)

businessRules.rule: Uploads validate first (dry run) and commit only if the data hasn't changed since the preview (hash includes the tournament data version → 409) and there are no errors (→ 422). A commit is one atomic batch and bumps the data version.

Teams, Players and Fixtures sheets replace the whole list; a row still in use (players, fixtures, points, squads, franchise owners) can't be deleted. Points replace per fixture; other fixtures are untouched.
Fixture ids restart at 1 in each series; a fixture is identified by tournament + series + fixture id. Start times are IST in the sheet and stored in UTC.
Moving an owned player to another team after an auction started is an error unless the superadmin overrides it (recorded).
Money is in lakhs. Bid ladder: +5 L under 1 Cr, +10 L to 2 Cr, +20 L to 5 Cr, +25 L above.
Reserve rule: a team may never bid more than its purse less what completing its minimum squad at the cheapest unsold base price would cost.

Franchise auction: runs before the player auction, one franchise per team, same purse. A franchise opens at max(base price, average sold so far rounded onto the ladder). On a missed turn a random unsold affordable franchise is nominated with the team as opening bidder; none affordable → skipped.
Player auction: a lot opens at the player's base price. Squad checks: cap = max size less penalty slots, role min/max, max per real team, max overseas, role minimums still reachable.
Missed player-auction turn: the first affordable allowed wishlist player is nominated; otherwise a penalty slot, redeemable for the league's price while the player auction isn't finished.
Turns move strictly round the ring (make-up turns first); a lot always sells (the nominator is the opening bidder); there are no mini-auctions — squads are final once the player auction completes.
Scoring: every squad player's points count; own-franchise players get total × boost% extra (negatives included). Tiebreakers: total, synergy, the team's best player, purse left.
The season is complete when every non-abandoned fixture has points, or when the admin marks it complete.
A team that owns a franchise is shown under the franchise's name.
Cricket leagues never enter FPL paths: gameweek routes refuse them, the auto-processing plan skips them, FPL pages redirect to /[slug]/cricket.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a sheet with an invalid row
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is refused with 422 and nothing changes

acceptanceCriteria.given: a preview made before another upload
points already uploaded for a fixture
acceptanceCriteria.when: that fixture's points are uploaded again
acceptanceCriteria.then: they are replaced and other fixtures keep theirs
its settings and every team's purse are stored; impossible squad rules are refused

acceptanceCriteria.given: a league with a franchise auction
acceptanceCriteria.when: the admin starts the player auction first
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is refused until the franchise auction completes

acceptanceCriteria.when: a team bids below the next ladder step or above its reserve-rule maximum

acceptanceCriteria.then: it opens at no less than 825

acceptanceCriteria.given: a player-auction nominator with a wishlist
acceptanceCriteria.then: their first affordable wishlist player is nominated at base price

acceptanceCriteria.given: a nominator with no usable wishlist
acceptanceCriteria.then: they get a penalty slot, which they can redeem for the league's price

acceptanceCriteria.given: many browsers connected to the auction
acceptanceCriteria.when: turns time out and lots sell
acceptanceCriteria.then: turns follow the ring with no skips or double turns and nothing sells twice
totals match a hand calculation including the boost

acceptanceCriteria.given: the admin completes the player auction with squads short of the minimum
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is refused and lists the short squads

acceptanceCriteria.when: an FPL page or gameweek route is used
acceptanceCriteria.then: the page redirects to the cricket page and the route returns 400

acceptanceCriteria.given: a sale made to the wrong team, before the player auction completes
acceptanceCriteria.when: the admin moves it to another team, at the same or a new price
acceptanceCriteria.then: the old owner is refunded and the new one charged, provided the new team could have bought it (squad rules, one franchise each, reserve rule); after the player auction completes, neither undo nor move is allowed

acceptanceCriteria.when: an FPL auction endpoint keyed by its league or team is called (wishlist, redeem-slot, finance, unsold, club-tiers)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a league tournament whose group stage is uploaded
acceptanceCriteria.when: the superadmin uploads its playoff fixtures in Playoffs mode
acceptanceCriteria.then: they are numbered on from the group stage's last fixture (blank ids filled in, wrong ones refused), the group stage is untouched, and players' match counts read '14 + playoffs*' before and '14 + N' after

acceptanceCriteria.given: players, fixtures and points sheets typed by hand
acceptanceCriteria.when: they name teams by code or full name and players by name, without player_id
acceptanceCriteria.then: rows match their players and teams; unknown names are errors with a suggestion, never a guess; blank player_ids are made from names

defects.title: A franchise sale could be undone after the player auction completed
defects.description: undoSale refused only when the lot's own session was a completed player session. A franchise lot belongs to the franchise session, so once the player auction had completed (squads final) the admin could still undo a franchise sale, refunding its price and removing the boost.
defects.expectedBehaviour: No sale of either kind can be undone (or moved) once the league's player auction has completed.
defects.actualBehaviour: Undoing a franchise sale after the player auction completed returned 200.
defects.notes: Found while adding the manual transfer correction.
defects.resolution: undoSale and transferSale both check the league's player session (squadsFinal) instead of the lot's session.
